testimonials.title: User Feedback
testimonials.subtitle: See how they got their dream offers through us

items.text: Coming from a non-CS background, I felt my foundation was weak. The resume prediction is incredible; it precisely hit 90% of the questions I faced in real interviews. It helped me connect knowledge from Spring IHC to AOP logically.
items.title: Social Java Dev

items.text: With a 996 schedule, I had no time for mock interviews. This platform is efficient and available 24/7. My interviewer asked about system design and logic, and the platform covered them all. I faced 70% similar questions in the final interview!
items.title: Go Developer

items.text: The follow-up questions drastically improved my ability to explain technical details. It dug into Redis AOF and optimization, exactly what I needed for senior roles.
items.title: Architect

items.text: I wanted to join a top company but system design was my weak point. The detailed reports and suggestions helped me clear my thoughts. I can now explain solutions clearly and got a great salary bump.
items.title: Backend Developer

items.text: Great! 1/10 price of manual services with 90% effectiveness. Best investment!
items.title: Backend Developer

items.text: Covered everything from Django ORM optimization to export views. Very comprehensive preparation.
items.title: Python Developer

items.question: Why use Interview Master instead of general AI like ChatGPT?
items.answer: We are deeply customized for interview scenarios. Our standard, follow-up logic, and evaluation system are much closer to real employer requirements.

items.question: What problem does it solve?
items.answer: It helps you find weaknesses before real interviews and provides structured evaluation and suggestions.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: From campus recruitment to experienced professionals, for anyone seeking technical roles or career changes.
